newsitem.title: USA: Waste Management seeks to buy Wheelabrator.
newsitem.headline: Waste Management seeks to buy Wheelabrator.

text.p: Waste Management Inc said Friday its board has extended a cash offer to acquire all the outstanding publicly held shares of Wheelabrator Technologies Inc for $15 a share.

Waste Management said in its statement that its offer represents a 15 percent premium to the closing price of $13 a share for Wheelabrator on June 19. Waste Management owns about 67 percent of Wheelabrator's 157 million shares.

"We have long stated that Wheelabrator's waste-to-energy operations are a core business whose facilities are an integral part of our North American service network and whose technology is important to the long-term prospects of Waste Management," Dean Buntrock, Waste Management chairman, said in a statement.
